span.p:
Guards (all enforced in app):
1. DB: unique arena per project; private.bound_project_id write-once
2. Tool token claims session_key + project_id
3. App Tools reject any resource outside token scope
4. Runtime contract: no cross-session memory
5. CI canary test: per-project canary strings never leak
